summary: search/sql's data-store diagnostics (mcpMissingStoreMessage, openMCPReadOnlyStore's open-failure message, mcpEmptyStoreNextStep -- all in internal/mcp/tools.go) now probe companion-binary resolution (mcpCompanionCLIAvailable, backed by the injectable mcpCLIPathResolver var defaulting to cobratree.SiblingCLIPath) before suggesting "run peloton-pp-cli sync". When the binary can't be resolved, all three return the same mcpCompanionCLIUnavailableMessage constant that command-mirror (shellout) tools already give in this situation, instead of prescribing a remedy that execs the same missing binary. Any future regen touching these three functions must keep the binary-resolution check first, and must route new tests for this behavior through stubMCPCLIAvailable rather than depending on whatever "peloton-pp-cli" resolution the real test machine/CI runner happens to produce.
reason: Live-tested dead-end loop: on a deployment missing the peloton-pp-cli binary, search reported "No local data store found... Run peloton-pp-cli sync before using MCP search/sql", while every other CLI-backed (command-mirror) tool correctly reported "companion CLI binary not found: exec: ..." for the identical root cause. Every path to running the suggested `sync` command execs the same missing binary, so an agent following the instruction literally loops until it gives up. search/sql read the local SQLite store directly and never exec the binary themselves, which is why they had their own, incorrect diagnosis instead of inheriting the shellout path's honest one.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. Updated TestMCPSearchMissingStoreIsActionable/TestMCPSearchEmptyStoreReturnsActionableEnvelope/TestMCPSQLMissingStoreIsActionable/TestMCPSQLEmptyStoreReturnsActionableEnvelope to stub the binary as available (matching their original store-focused intent, since a real `go test` run has no real "peloton-pp-cli" to resolve and would otherwise silently hit the new code path). New tests TestMCPSearchMissingStoreAndBinaryGivesConsistentDiagnosis, TestMCPSQLMissingStoreAndBinaryGivesConsistentDiagnosis, and TestMCPSearchEmptyStoreAndMissingBinaryNamesRootCause stub the binary as unavailable and assert the corrected message/next_step, and that neither still says "Run peloton-pp-cli sync".
